instruction: Transfer the optical cuvette from the staging rack into the spectrophotometer sample holder, align its optical windows along the beam path, close the sample-compartment lid, and clear hands.

occupational_relevance.description: Routine analytical chemistry and clinical sample analysis: loading standard 10 mm pathlength optical cuvettes into benchtop UV-Vis spectrophotometers for quantitative absorbance, optical density (OD600), and assay measurements without optical distortion from stray light or finger oils.

physical_mechanism.spectrophotometer: Benchtop UV-Vis instrument chassis with recessed sample holder pocket and light beam passage along the Y axis
physical_mechanism.sample_lid: Light-tight compartment cover attached via revolute hinge joint (0 to 75 deg travel)
physical_mechanism.optical_cuvette: Standard 12.5 x 12.5 x 45.0 mm optical cuvette with opposing frosted handling sides along X and opposing polished clear optical windows along Y

scoring.0.25: Cuvette lifted vertically clear of staging rack
scoring.0.50: Cuvette seated squarely and upright inside spectrophotometer sample socket
scoring.0.75: Cuvette seated and hinged sample-compartment lid closed flush (<= 8 deg)
scoring.1.00: All criteria met with robot hands retracted clear (> 40 mm) for 20-step stillness hold
